workflows.name: Order to shipment
workflows.trigger: A customer places an order that needs to be shipped
steps: Create order with line items
Select or confirm shipping address
Convert order to one or more shipments
Pack parcels per shipment
Continue into the shipment lifecycle

provenance.notes: karrio's Order.DIRECT_PROPS includes line_items/shipping_to and Shipment.order_id links back to it; single source.

workflows.name: Shipment lifecycle
workflows.trigger: A shipment is booked with a carrier after rate selection
steps: Request rates from connected carriers
Select a rate and purchase label
Hand off to carrier (pickup or drop-off)
Carrier scans update transit status
Out for delivery
Delivered, or exception raised

provenance.notes: State names and the linear progression are verbatim from karrio's ShipmentStatus enum (single source for exact values); the general multi-stage creation-to-delivery shape is cross-referenced against fleetbase's order lifecycle flags (dispatched/started/status), which is why this is scored medium rather than low.

workflows.name: Tracking and visibility
workflows.trigger: A carrier or driver scan/webhook event arrives for a shipment
steps: Receive carrier webhook or telematics event
Normalize to a tracking event with status/code/location
Append to the shipment's tracking timeline
Push update to customer-facing tracking page
Notify customer on major status change

provenance.notes: karrio's TrackerStatus enum and fleetbase's fleetbase_tracking_statuses table are independent implementations. No formal state machine is included here because scans can arrive out of order across carriers; see the tracking_event entity's states list for the allowed status vocabulary.

workflows.name: Dispatch and route planning
workflows.trigger: One or more orders are ready to be routed and dispatched
steps: Batch pending orders/stops
Optimize stop sequence into a route
Assign a driver and vehicle
Dispatch the route/manifest to the driver app
Driver executes stops in sequence
Route/manifest marked complete

provenance.notes: Inferred from fleetbase_orders' dispatched/dispatched_at/started/started_at boolean+timestamp pairs; exact status string values are not enumerated in the schema, so state names are reasoned by convention. Single source.

workflows.name: Pickup scheduling
workflows.trigger: A shipper needs a carrier or driver to collect one or more shipments
steps: Choose a pickup date and time window
Schedule pickup with carrier or dispatch
Carrier/driver confirms or the pickup is closed out
Pickup can be cancelled before collection

provenance.notes: Verbatim from karrio's PickupStatus enum; single source.

workflows.name: Proof of delivery capture
workflows.trigger: A driver arrives at the final stop for a delivery
steps: Arrive at delivery stop
Capture signature and/or photo per required pod_method
Upload capture (queued if offline)
Attach to the shipment/order record
Mark stop and order complete

provenance.notes: karrio's delivery_image_url/signature_image_url fields and fleetbase's payloads.pod_method/pod_required columns are independent implementations. No state_machine is included; capture is a single terminal action per stop, not a multi-stage lifecycle.

workflows.name: Exception and returns handling
workflows.trigger: A delivery attempt fails, damage is reported, or a customer requests a return
steps: Log the exception with type/category/priority
Investigate (contact driver, carrier, or customer)
Decide resolution: redeliver, return, refund, or claim
If returning, generate a return shipment/label
Resolve and close the exception

provenance.notes: fleetbase_issues (type/category/priority/resolved_at) is the direct implementation for the exception lifecycle; karrio's needs_attention/delivery_failed status and return_shipment/is_return fields corroborate the trigger and return path from a second source. The specific open/investigating/resolved/closed state names are reasoned, not verbatim from either schema.

workflows.name: Fleet maintenance scheduling
workflows.trigger: A vehicle approaches a maintenance interval (date, distance, or engine hours)
steps: System computes next_due_date/odometer/engine_hours from the interval
Reminder sent at configured offsets before due
Vehicle is taken out of dispatch rotation for service
Service is recorded, resetting the interval baseline

provenance.notes: fleetbase_maintenance_schedules (interval_method/type/value, next_due_date, reminder_offsets) and fleetbase_maintenance_schedule_reminders; single source.
